title: StarbaseHullsResponse
description: Response shape for GET /model/starbase/hulls — full starbase-hull catalog.

slug.description: Stable machine identifier (lower-snake: ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$); safe for URLs, filenames, and asset lookups. Engine-emitted from a fixed catalog and validated by the starbase-hulls contract test, so the constraint is documented here rather than enforced as a generated newtype (see docs/adr/0003 on weighing pattern constraints against type churn).

name.description: Display name as shown in the original game (e.g. 'Space Station', 'Death Star').

requirement.description: Trait gating, or null when available to all races.

dock-capacity.description: Maximum ship hull mass (kT) this starbase can build or repair. 0 means it can do neither (Orbital Fort). Absent means unlimited (∞): Space Station, Ultra Station, Death Star.

hull-requirement.description: Trait gate restricting which races may build a starbase hull. 'AR' = Alternate Reality PRT only (Death Star). 'ISB' = Improved Starbases LRT only (Space Dock, Ultra Station). See the owning property for the null (available-to-all) case.

max-count.description: Maximum parts this slot can hold.

slot-position.description: Grid coordinates of the slot in the Ship Designer layout, matching the original game. The unit is half a slot box; the origin is the top-left of the hull's slot cluster.
